exact_statement: For every integer r>=7, the Boolean G_r in THIRD_QUERY_PROOF.md is one physical vertex edit of a triple-parity-coded seed of Fourier support distance at least 3, has odd negative count and no nontrivial Boolean tensor factorization, satisfies H(G_r)<=3 I(G_r), and admits an original three-query selector block with entropy decrement L3>(2r-3)2^(-2r) and influence debit Q3=3*2^(-2r)-6*2^(-6r-3). Thus L3/Q3 is unbounded. For every fixed K>=9 and r>=7 with 2r-3>3K, the complete three-query bank B3=L3-KQ3 is positive although its retained two-query prefix bank B2<-2^(-6r-4). In particular r16,K9 gives B3>2*2^(-32). This refutes the proposed all-policy third-query extension, not FEI or an existential critical-source selector.
